question:
Select the figure from the options that can replace the question mark (?) and complete the given pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c83b78103cbdd977822b3ad10970868dcd8ad355280a5121ef2e8672f87234f.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**Logic:**

1. (5) moves in the upper row and changes into (2) and then (2) changes into (5) alternatively.

2. The triangle moves in the middle column as shown below.

3. The circle is moving clockwise to the middle and corners of the square perimeter.

From Figure (1) to (2):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbcc41479d2904b45ad48b083e2d80771446227cd78363585ac3ebff4e2ef0d9.png] 

From Figure (2) to (3):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcc0d7b9662417c97bcb050e65647087f9869e5c8bd7e9aef28ce5f7e98b3cc1.png] 

From Figure (3) to (4):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76f9d98d88df9139b7448c24cb79b1840657541e057b2e282309443cfd05af25.png] 

From Figure (4) to Answer Figure (5):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/071403a54e8098c4551d4b398d0627e4ee2a12525a802508b1aed8be0eeac367.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
